assets.prompt: Use the supplied screenshot as the exact material and illustration reference for a live Chinese career game UI. Warm ivory fibrous watercolor paper, precision cut edges, visible layer thickness, soft realistic ambient occlusion and gentle light from upper left. The output is a production decorative background asset, not a screenshot of a webpage. NO text, letters, numbers, borders, surrounding card frame, badges, buttons, logos, mascot or watermark. Only the RIGHT 30% contains the main small physical sculpture, with extremely shallow layered colored paper hills along the bottom 10%. Restrained and elegant, not a busy diorama, not a line icon in a square tile. Match the reference's book/laptop/mountain artwork scale and lighting. Route A blue palette: powder blue and muted cornflower blue #3179ba. The sole sculpture is a little OPEN BOOK in three-quarter front view, with thick cream paper leaves, delicate raised blank page rules, visible blue hard-paper cover and spine, casting a soft lower-right shadow. Place book on right at 77%-95% horizontal and 40%-80% vertical. Two small powder-blue folded leaf accents at bottom right. No words on pages.
